messages.subject: GCC Corporate Affairs Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Taylor Birchwood Team,

Your corporate-affairs executive-search coverage across London and Dubai, including the GCC, is closely aligned with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory coordination and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
